==Skin Trivia==
*The vest from the Level 3+ Default, {{Color|Valentine|Valentines}}, {{Color|Bunny|Bunny}}, {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}}, and {{Color|Spooky|Ghost}} skins currently wear are the [[w:c:r2da:Faraday Vest|Faraday Vest]] from ''R2DA'', which, in turn, is named after the scientist [[wp:Michael Faraday|Michael Faraday]], who studied electrochemistry.
**The creator of this vest is BelowNatural, who also created Tower Defense Simulator.
*The Tesla Tower originally used by all skins at Level 2+ was a nod to the [[wp:Wardenclyffe Tower|Wardenclyffe Tower]] in Shoreham, Long Island, New York created by Nikola Tesla.
*The Lightning Cannon used by the Level 4-5 '''Electroshocker''' may have been based on the [[w:c:robloxarsenal:Lightning Cannon|Lightning Cannon]] from ''Arsenal''.
*The duck on the level 4-5 Lightning Cannon of the {{Color|Ducky|Ducky}} resembles the [[Evil Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Evil Ducky]] that appeared in [[D00M's Revenge]].
*The {{Color|Deluxe|TeeVee}} skin is based on [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:TV Man|TV Men]] from ''Skibidi Toilet''.
**The Level 4-5 appearance appears to have been based on the [[w:c:skibidi-toilet:Titan TV Man|Upgraded Titan TV Man]].
*The {{Color|Surf|Jellyfish}} skin is a submission from the [https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1D68qT3NUsa896BUM-KBc4FhRZp6NFVK6HXmaR7alHEg Aquatic Fantasy] skin set made by 4it3dm1 and InkEve.
**The skin originally was a human wearing a jellyfish costume. It was changed into an anthropomorphic jellyfish when it was added into the game.
**Originally, Level 0-3 would attack enemies using a spell book. This ended up not being used outside of Level 4-5, but even on these Levels it is the jellyfish attacking enemies.
*According to the [[Electroshocker Jellyfish Charm]], the {{Color|Surf|Jellyfish}} skin is the result of splicing an '''Electroshocker''' tower with a jellyfish.
*The {{Color|Valentines2026|Lovestriker}} skin may be a reference to [https://lovebullet.wiki/wiki/Sakurada_Koharu Koharu] and [https://lovebullet.wiki/wiki/Ena Ena] from ''Love Bullet''.
*The {{Color|Beach}} skin is non-binary as stated its creator.<ref name="beachmodelcreator">https://x.com/raincoatedd/status/2073074706564165660</ref>
*The model of the {{Color|Beach}} was made by mitzu<ref name="beachmodelcreator"/> while the concept art was made by petloaches.<ref>https://x.com/petloaches/status/2073075336049262660</ref>
*The {{Color|Premium|Black Cat}} skin is based on [https://magic-cat-academy.fandom.com/wiki/Momo Momo] from ''Magic Cat Academy''.<ref name="momo">https://x.com/luigi_star1/status/2100981740743401594</ref>
*The {{Color|Premium|Black Cat}} skin was made by luigi_star1.<ref name="momo"/>

===Roblox Catalog===
*The Level 0-4 visor used by the '''Electroshocker''' is a re-textured version of the [https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Visor_(series) Roblox Visor] series from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 1-4 goggles used by the '''Electroshocker''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*The skull seen on the {{Color|Banned|Banned}} skin is a recolored version of [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/4765718/The-Riddling-Skull The Riddling Skull] from the Roblox catalog.
*The Level 0-4 horns seen on the  skin are horns from [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/1474657/The-Dusekkar The Dusekkar] Roblox item.
*The Level 5 horns seen on the {{Color|Banned|Banned}} skin are retextured version of the [https://roblox.fandom.com/wiki/Flaming_Horns_(series) Flaming Horns] series from the Roblox catalog.
*Legs seen on the {{Color|Banned|Banned}} skin are retextured legs of [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/192/Korblox-Deathspeaker Korblox Deathspeaker's] package found in Roblox catalog.
